description: This file defines the 'Action' class within the 'Opencart.System.Engine' namespace. The class handles routing and execution of controller actions in the OpenCart framework. It provides methods to parse a route string, retrieve the route identifier, and execute the corresponding controller method, including caching controller objects in a registry.

classes.name: Action
classes.description: Represents an encapsulation of a route and method in the OpenCart framework, providing execution logic for dispatching controller actions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Action object by parsing the route string into route and method components.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the route identifier string associated with this action.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the controller action specified by the route, invoking the appropriate method and handling controller object caching via the registry.
